description: A wide 16:9 left-to-right pipeline diagram in two rows. TOP ROW, labelled at its left 'once, before any question': three rounded boxes joined by arrows: box 1 'Parse' with the small line '693 files → 51,325 units'; box 2 'Chunk' with the small line '200-token chunks, each with its document header'; box 3 'Index' containing two small stacked shapes labelled 'BM25 keyword index' and 'Chroma vectors'. On the far left of the top row, a stack of mixed document sheets labelled 'northbridge-docs'. BOTTOM ROW, labelled at its left 'on every question': a speech-bubble shaped box 'Emma: Can I buy the battery packs from Brightcell Energy?', an arrow to box 4 'Search' with the small line 'top 20 candidates', an arrow to box 5 'Rerank' with the small line 'a cross-encoder reads question + passage', an arrow to box 6 'Answer' with the small line 'only from the top 10, every fact cited [1] [2]'. A thin vertical arrow from the 'Index' box down into 'Search'. Boxes 1 to 3 in light grey with dark-grey outlines; boxes 4 to 6 in light sky blue with blue outlines. No other labels.

A wide 16:9 diagram of an LLM-maintained wiki with three horizontal layers stacked from bottom to top. BOTTOM layer, a wide light-grey band labelled 'Raw sources (never edited)': a row of small document sheets labelled PDF, XLSX, EML, YAML, DOCX. MIDDLE layer, a wide light sky-blue band labelled 'The wiki (pages the LLM writes)': about seven small page cards joined by thin link lines, two of them labelled 'index.md' and 'log.md', the others labelled 'sup-brightcell-energy', 'pol-pur-001', 'sop-pur-001', 'err-po-0412', 'items-bat'. TOP layer, a narrow green-outlined band labelled 'The schema: AGENTS.md (people write it)'. On the right side, three labelled curved arrows: 'Ingest' going up from the raw sources into the wiki; 'Query' going from a small question bubble into index.md and then along the links; 'Lint' as a small loop on the wiki band. No other labels, no people.
